name: @peak-state/onboarding
description: Peak State onboarding: the question harness that elicits one state's strategy and plays it back.

scripts.worker:dev: npm run build:harness && wrangler d1 migrations apply peak-state --local && wrangler dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.worker:deploy: npm run build:harness && wrangler d1 migrations apply peak-state --remote && wrangler deploy
